name: Florence
gaps: Source query returned 10107 rows; 10091 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are County Tax Parcel (REPL_Parcels_Owners) (https://services1.arcgis.com/40L6yX6OtdCifNez/arcgis/rest/services/County_Tax_Parcel/FeatureServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
No countywide zoning FeatureServer verified on dig day (Olanta downtown + gateway studies only; City of Florence Zoning MapServer is localhost.flocity.local — not public).
Assessor CGI deep links are HTTP; pattern uses map/block/parcel from TMS parts.
Sale multi-history via PROPERTYHISTORY CGI, not attributes on GIS layer.
